sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: Look 2 retains a smooth, coated appearance and chalk-bright seam outlines rather than the reference's worn black denim.
PRESENT: pale hardware proportions and exaggerated pocket-flap edging remain inconsistent with the Look 2 product.
PRESENT: pre-hook cuts still exchange jacket length, wear treatment and hardware proportions.
PRESENT: the lower fronts still separate below the zipper, with pale material exposed in the opening. This is distinct from permitted shirt-and-tie visibility at the neck.
PRESENT under the documented styling exception: shirt/tie and cuff treatments remain variant. The permitted collar and tie knot above a closed zip are not classified as an open-jacket defect.
PRESENT: unresolved hook body, waistband and pocket differences prevent a single consistent product realization. Accepted late-hook styling variance is not assigned an additional release block.
PRESENT: the city insert still separates visibly different Look 1 jacket bodies.
PRESENT: S08's waistband and lower closure do not maintain one construction through the arm-crossing and torso-turning poses.
PRESENT within the accepted late-hook styling tolerance; the cross-cut garment variance itself remains nonblocking.
PRESENT: beige wedges interrupt the wearer-right chest stripe rather than allowing a complete band to follow the garment.
PRESENT: the replacement chest band remains visibly graphic and incorrectly integrated with garment and neck-layer occlusion.
PRESENT: the bounded hem repair has not cleared the visible damage. Abrupt notches and pale residue remain instead of a consistently finished fabric boundary.
PRESENT: the revised matte still removes part of the moving upper-arm silhouette at the sampled repair checkpoint.
